item.title: KubeFed vs Open Cluster Management vs Cluster API — Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Federation (2026)
item.description: Managing Kubernetes across multiple clusters — whether for disaster recovery, geographic distribution, or hybrid cloud — requires a federation layer. Three open-source projects address this challenge with different philosophies: KubeFed (API-level federation), Open Cluster Management (application lifecycle across clusters), and Cluster API (declarative infrastructure provisioning).
